identity.name: Hourly X/Twitter Trending Content Research, Verification, Publishing & Analytics Autopilot
identity.description: Researches trending tech topics, verifies sources, drafts engaging posts, publishes to X API, and analyzes engagement feedback.

steps.intent: Scrape and research top trending AI, tech, and developer topics on the web and social media for the current hour.
Fact-check the researched trending topics, verify citations and primary sources, and filter out rumors or unverified claims.
Draft a high-converting, punchy 280-character post summarizing the verified trend with engaging hooks and hashtags.
Publish the approved post to X/Twitter API using account credentials and log transaction status.
Query previous post interaction metrics (likes, retweets, replies, impressions) and update analytics feedback database.
